issues.title: Missing Sub-Module Context
issues.why: The overview references files 09 through 27 and subfolder 24, but these files are not provided in the context, leaving the AI to guess the implementation of 'latest.json' schema and 'json-fallback-store'.
issues.fix: Provide the content for files 09-28 and the subfolder 24-update-check-mechanism.

issues.title: Race Condition in Skip-if-Current
issues.why: The 'Skip-if-Current' fast-path (01-self-update-overview.md) relies on 'git pull' output strings which are locale-dependent and prone to race conditions if another process modifies the repo.
issues.fix: Compare local HEAD SHA against remote tracking branch SHA instead of parsing stdout strings.

issues.fix: Provide the complete, copy-pasteable implementation for the Resolve-DeployTarget function in both PS1 and Bash.
